_meta.openai/widgetDescription: iPayX FX forensic audit result. Shows FX Score, spread, overpayment vs mid-market benchmark.

description: Returns the live mid-market FX rate for a currency pair (Twelve Data, Open Exchange Rates fallback), in both directions (pair and inverted_pair). Inputs: currency_from, currency_to, optional bank_rate. When bank_rate is given, the output also includes the spread versus mid-market; both quote directions (rate and 1/rate) are tested, the closer one is kept and flagged as inverted when 1/rate wins; a rate more than 10% from mid-market in both directions is rejected as incoherent.

examples.name: Spread analysis vs a bank rate

bank_rate.description: Optional bank/broker rate. When provided, returns spread vs mid-market and tests both quote directions; >10% off in both → rejected as incoherent.

name: check_fx_mid_market_rate
title: Check FX Mid-Market Rate
